basic_details.job_title: MAHE Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Project Research Scientist I, Project Technical Support III Posts
basic_details.post_name: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) and Project Technical Support III

qualification.education_qualification: First Class Post Graduate Degree / Post Graduate Degree in Pharmacy
qualification.details: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): First Class Post Graduate Degree (Pharm D/M Pharm – Pharmacology/Medical Devices) or integrated PG degrees with three years' experience or PhD. Prior research experience in design, development and clinical validation of point-of-care (POC) devices, and good scientific writing skills. Project Technical Support III: Post Graduate Degree in Pharmacy (Pharm D/M Pharm – Pharmaceutical Chemistry/Pharmacology). Prior experience in handling and executing tasks related to clinical studies is highly desirable.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 28,000 to Rs. 56,000 per month + 10% HRA

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for MAHE Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: MAHE Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the MAHE Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download MAHE Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): First Class Post Graduate Degree (Pharm D/M Pharm – Pharmacology/Medical Devices) or integrated PG degrees with three years' experience or PhD. Prior research experience in design, development and clinical validation of point-of-care (POC) devices, and good scientific writing skills. Project Technical Support III: Post Graduate Degree in Pharmacy (Pharm D/M Pharm – Pharmaceutical Chemistry/Pharmacology). Prior experience in handling and executing tasks related to clinical studies is highly desirable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MAHE Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) for hiring research personnel under an ICMR-funded project based in Karnataka.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MAHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available across different project-based research and technical support positions announced in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What are the specific posts available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) with 1 vacancy and Project Technical Support - III with 3 vacancies.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the detailed CV and supporting documents via email is October 31, 2026. Applicants must ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for MAHE posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via email. Candidates are required to send their CV and documents to [email protected] with a copy marked to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. Is mentioning the job code mandatory while applying?
faq.answer: Yes, mentioning the correct Job Code in the subject line of the email application is mandatory for proper categorization and consideration.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Project Research Scientist - I?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) position will receive a salary of Rs. 56,000/- plus 10% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the educational qualification required for Technical Support - III?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Pharmacy (Pharm D/M Pharm – Pharmaceutical Chemistry/Pharmacology) along with relevant clinical study experience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of candidates based on their CV and qualifications, followed by a personal or technical interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of the university?
faq.answer: You can visit the official Manipal Academy of Higher Education website at manipal.edu for further updates, notices, and institutional information regarding research programs.
